ROOT_CAUSE_DIMENSIONS: LOT_ID, SITE_NUM, TEMP_C, VDD

ROOT_CAUSE_VALUES: LOT_ID=L45; SITE_NUM=3; TEMP_C=25; VDD=0.85

ROOT_CAUSE_STRUCTURE: interaction

ROOT_CAUSE_EVIDENCE: measured

FINDINGS

1. Overall yield is 95.79% (158 failed parts out of 3750), with a measurement fail rate of 0.144% (get_overall_yield, no filters).

2. L45 has the lowest lot yield at 95.07% (0.164% fail rate) vs. L48 best at 96.67% (0.116% fail rate) (get_yield_summary, group_by=LOT_ID).

3. W01 has the lowest wafer yield at 94.4% (0.191% fail rate) vs. W02 best at 96.53% (0.116% fail rate) (get_yield_summary, group_by=WAFER_ID).

4. Site 3 has poor yield at 94.32% (0.189% fail rate) vs. Site 8 best at 97.11% (0.096% fail rate) (get_yield_summary, group_by=SITE_NUM).

5. L45 + Site 3 shows 88.42% yield (0.386% fail rate), substantially worse than L45 overall at 95.07% (get_yield_summary, group_by=SITE_NUM, filtered by LOT_ID=L45).

6. Room temperature (25°C) fails at 0.171% rate vs. cold (0°C) at 0.107% overall (get_fail_rate_by_condition, no filters).

7. VDD=0.85 fails at 0.157% vs. VDD=0.75 at 0.133% overall (get_fail_rate_by_condition, no filters).

8. L45 + Site 3 + TEMP_C=25 + VDD=0.85 yields only 93.55% with a catastrophic measurement fail rate of 2.013% (get_overall_yield, filtered by LOT_ID=L45, SITE_NUM=3, TEMP_C=25, VDD=0.85).

9. At the same lot/site/temperature but VDD=0.8 or 0.75, L45 + Site 3 achieves 100% yield (get_overall_yield, filtered by LOT_ID=L45, SITE_NUM=3, TEMP_C=25, VDD=0.8/0.75).

10. L45 + Site 3 at room temperature shows elevated failures at VDD=0.85 (0.625% fail rate) and VDD=0.75 (0.314% fail rate), but only 0.211% at cold 0°C (get_fail_rate_by_condition, filtered by LOT_ID=L45, SITE_NUM=3).

11. The combination L45 + Site 3 + TEMP_C=25 + VDD=0.85 accounts for 6 failed parts, with sram_bist at 6.897% fail rate and vmin_core at 5.263% fail rate in this subset (get_failures_by_test, filtered by LOT_ID=L45, SITE_NUM=3, TEMP_C=25, VDD=0.85).

RULED OUT

1. Spatial position (die location on wafer) does not systematically explain the pattern; while W octant shows elevated 0.2% fail rate and edge shows 0.168% overall (get_yield_by_region, no filters), the L45 + Site 3 failures are distributed across centre (0.417%), S (0.392%), SE (0.455%), and W (0.417%) octants without a clear localized defect signature (get_yield_by_region, filtered by LOT_ID=L45, WAFER_ID=W01).

2. All lots and all wafers are affected by Site 3, not an isolated batch defect.

3. The L45 + Site 3 combination is independent of wafer identity; Site 3 shows elevated failures across W01, W02, W03 at similar rates near 0.21% (get_yield_summary, group_by=WAFER_ID, filtered by SITE_NUM=3).

ASSESSMENT

The data supports a strong four-way interaction: **L45 is systematically marginal at Site 3 under room temperature (25°C) and elevated supply voltage (0.85V)**. This is not a spatial defect, not a general Site 3 problem (other lots pass), and not a general L45 problem (better yields at other sites and conditions). The 2.013% measurement fail rate at L45+Site 3+25°C+0.85V is more than 14× the overall population rate of 0.144%. Confidence is high because the specific combination was directly measured and shows dramatic yield collapse. The failure signature (sram_bist and vmin_core elevated) suggests a silicon margining issue—the test equipment at Site 3 may be running hotter or the applied voltage supply is drifting higher under room-temperature insertion conditions, stressing a specific population (L45) that is already near its lower Vmin specification at VDD=0.85V.

RECOMMENDED NEXT STEP

Investigate Site 3's temperature chamber calibration and supply voltage accuracy during room-temperature (25°C) insertion testing, specifically for VDD=0.85V rail voltage supply tolerance and tester thermal gradient near Site 3's position. Cross-check L45's silicon characterization data (process corners, Vmin distributions) against Site 3 test conditions and site-specific parametric drift logs. Determine whether the issue has resolved in newer lots (L46, L47, L48 show better Site 3 yields at 94.74%, 97.89%, 97.89% respectively, suggesting a time-dependent condition in L45 specifically).

Now let me also check the L45 + Site 2 combination and get a full picture:
